title: Lead notice
description: One notice in a project's lead inbox (the lead-inbox plugin, docs/design/notifications.md#the-leads-inbox): what needs the project's lead, or what finished, made from recorded events only and addressed to `lead:<project>`. It is read through MCP `lead_inbox`, waited for with `system lead wait`, and pushed to the project's configured sinks (a command's stdin, a line of a file). It names ids, kinds, times, counts, and the command to act; it never carries a secret, a prompt, an answer, a request's summary, or a command a request would run. Egress classification: operator-shared.

id.description: `<project>:<kind>:<subject>:<event seq>`: the same event never makes two notices of one kind for a project.

project.description: The board project the notice belongs to; a lead of another project never sees it.

to.description: The lead principal it is addressed to, `lead:<project>` (ADR-0076).

kind.description: result.held: a board task's result waits in review for a person (heavy tier, or a required check unknown); merge.held: a merge request of the project waits for a verdict; worker.question: a Worker asked a question instead of answering; task.retries-spent: a task's attempts are spent and it waits for input; task.landing-gave-up: a landing refused or gave up (a target that moved again after its rebases, a branch that cannot merge); request.outside-rights: a request the lead's token was refused on, which needs the operator; request.stale: an open request of the project is older than the configured minutes; quota.idle: ready tasks wait while Workers that could take them are free; live-update.done / live-update.failed: a live update ended; task.landed: one task landed, with its commit; task.digest: the landings of an interval, batched.

subject.description: What the notice is about, and what deduplication counts by (with the project and the kind): the task id, the request id, or, for a digest, `digest:<interval start>`.

at.description: When the event was recorded; for a time-based notice (request.stale, quota.idle, task.digest), when it was made.

event.description: The event-log entry it was made from; a time-based notice names the last event the inbox had read (`lead-inbox.sweep`).

act.description: The exact commands the lead runs to act, most direct first.

taskId.description: The board task it is about, when it is about one.

commit.description: task.landed: the commit that holds the change on the landing branch.

changed.description: task.landed: what the change is in one line (the diff's summary: files, insertions, deletions).

landed.description: task.digest: the landings of the interval, at most 50.
